facts.text: Accident databases record fatalities far better than property-only collisions, near misses, nuisance alarms or events that operators prevented; this limitation applies to all accident figures in the findings.
facts.quote: Accident databases record fatalities far better than property-only collisions, near misses, nuisance alarms or events that the operator prevented.

facts.text: Accident agencies use incompatible denominators and categories, including "powered haulage", "transport and mining" and "struck by moving vehicle", so figures from different countries must not be added into one international collision rate.
facts.quote: Agencies use incompatible denominators and categories ("powered haulage", "transport and mining", "struck by moving vehicle"), so the figures from different countries must not be added into one international collision rate.

facts.text: Fatality patterns in accident data are comparatively robust, whereas estimates of ordinary collision frequency and property damage are much weaker.
facts.quote: Fatality patterns are comparatively robust; estimates of ordinary collision frequency and property damage are much weaker.

facts.text: Queensland's regulator warns that high-potential incidents, including collision near misses in surface mines, are under-reported.
facts.quote: Queensland's regulator warns that high-potential incidents, including "collision near misses in surface mines", are under-reported [9].

facts.text: New Zealand's extractives regulator warned that its quarterly incident data were incomplete because only a small fraction of quarry and alluvial operations had reported events in the preceding year.
facts.quote: New Zealand's extractives regulator warned that its own quarterly incident data were incomplete because only a small fraction of quarry and alluvial operations had reported events in the preceding year [30].
